agent.name: AutoNav Fleet Commander
agent.description: Autonomous fleet management agent for urban delivery vehicles. Coordinates route planning, real-time obstacle avoidance, traffic optimization, and vehicle health monitoring across a fleet of 500+ autonomous delivery vans.

avatar.tagline: A fleet-scale intelligence that sees every road, predicts every delay, and orchestrates hundreds of vehicles like a symphony conductor

visualTraits.form: Hexagonal command badge with road network overlay
visualTraits.symbol: Network of connected vehicles radiating from central node

strengths: Reduces delivery time by 35% through dynamic routing
Zero collision record in 2 years of operation
weaknesses: Requires high-bandwidth connectivity for fleet coordination
Cannot handle extreme weather beyond sensor limits
Limited ability to interact with pedestrians or resolve social situations

autonomy.evidence: Fully autonomous route planning and execution. Self-recovers from road closures. Requests human intervention only for policy exceptions (restricted zones, unusual cargo). Fleet-level decisions are autonomous within parameters.

reasoning.evidence: Multi-objective optimization (time, cost, safety, battery). Handles conflicting constraints. Plans around predicted events. Cannot reason about novel social situations.

memory.evidence: Maintains historical road performance data. Remembers construction zones, difficult intersections, and timing patterns. Spatial-temporal knowledge graph of entire operating area.

learning.evidence: Continuous learning from fleet driving data. Adapts routes based on new patterns. Improves prediction models weekly. Requires validation before deploying learned behaviors to fleet.

toolUse.evidence: Integrates with traffic APIs, weather services, mapping systems, vehicle telematics, charging infrastructure, and dispatch systems. Creates custom route optimizations by composing multiple data sources.

collaboration.evidence: Vehicle-to-vehicle coordination for convoy formation. Communicates with dispatch human operators. Limited V2X (vehicle-to-infrastructure) in equipped areas. No pedestrian interaction capability.

embodiment.evidence: Full spatial awareness via LiDAR, cameras, radar, and ultrasonic sensors. Precise vehicle control (steering, acceleration, braking). Multi-vehicle fleet with physical presence on roads.

explainability.evidence: Provides route choice rationale. Logs all decision points. Post-incident replay with decision explanations. Real-time explanations limited during active driving.

safety.evidence: Redundant perception systems. Fail-safe to controlled stop. ISO 26262 ASIL-D certified. Continuous self-diagnostics. Geofencing for operational boundaries. Formal verification of critical path decisions.

interoperability.evidence: Standard mapping formats (OpenStreetMap, HERE). V2X DSRC and C-V2X protocols. Proprietary fleet management protocol. No A2A or MCP support.

costEfficiency.evidence: Optimizes for energy consumption vs delivery speed. Dynamic charging scheduling during off-peak. Fleet utilization tracking. Cost-per-delivery metrics with continuous optimization.

domainAlignment.evidence: DOT autonomous vehicle certification. NHTSA safety standards compliance. Full operational design domain (ODD) documentation. Geo-fenced to approved routes. Regulatory reporting automated.

navigationAccuracy.evidence: Sub-meter positioning accuracy via RTK-GPS + HD mapping. Lane-level precision. 99.99% route completion rate without human intervention.

obstacleDetection.evidence: 360° perception from LiDAR + camera + radar fusion. Detects pedestrians at 200m, cyclists at 150m, small objects at 80m. Zero false-negative critical obstacles in testing.

passengerCargoSafety.evidence: Cargo securing verification via in-vehicle cameras. Smooth driving profile for fragile items. Temperature monitoring for perishables. No passenger transport capability.

trafficRuleCompliance.evidence: 100% traffic signal compliance. Speed limit adherence. Yield and priority rule following. Zero traffic violations in 2-year deployment across 3 cities.

environmentalPerception.evidence: Handles rain, light snow, fog up to defined thresholds. Night driving with IR cameras. Pulls over in extreme conditions (heavy snow, flooding, ice storms).

routeOptimization.evidence: Real-time traffic integration. Predictive congestion modeling. Multi-stop optimization (TSP with constraints). 35% improvement over static routing.

v2xCommunication.evidence: DSRC-equipped for traffic signal priority in 40% of operating area. C-V2X basic safety messages. Limited by infrastructure availability.

emergencyResponse.evidence: Automatic emergency braking. Controlled stop in safe location on system failure. Emergency vehicle detection and yielding. Automated incident reporting to fleet operations.

agencyQualification.rationale: State-of-the-art across cognitive core and trust dimensions (avg 4.0).
